fresh_validation_proof.description: Current-run validation command, exit status, and relevant output; use blocked when proof cannot be produced.

coordination_review.description: Single-agent or parallel-worker join review covering worker scopes, accepted evidence, rejected or stale outputs, conflicts, and resolution.

user_change_review.description: Current-run git status and preservation action for pre-existing user changes, including none observed when the working tree was checked and clean.

included_context.description: Files, artifacts, source notes, or prior handoff fragments intentionally kept in context for the next agent.

excluded_context.description: Plausible but intentionally omitted context, with reason when omission could affect scope.

read_files.description: Files read for this run or inherited from a checked compaction/handoff.

modified_files.description: Files modified in this run or inherited from a checked compaction/handoff.

compaction.description: Summary of how older conversation, branch, or source context was compacted, or 'none needed' when no compaction occurred.

freshness.description: Change that would make this context boundary stale and force a recheck.

context_boundary.description: Boundary that separates selected context from intentionally omitted context so resume agents do not reload everything or trust hidden state.

artifact_paths.description: Paths to the primary artifacts, templates, schemas, logs, reports, or changed files that a resuming agent must inspect before continuing.

stop_conditions.description: Specific blockers, approval gaps, loop limits, safety limits, or missing evidence that stopped or would stop the run.
